message.content:
Berikut ekstraksi field **Form Applicant Information** (oranHR) berdasarkan screenshot:

### **Section: Identitas Pelamar (Kiri Atas)**
*   **Applicant Id*** : `96` *(Auto-generated, mandatory)*
*   **First Name*** : `[Text Field]` *(Mandatory)*
*   **Last Name** : `[Text Field]`
*   **Date Applied*** : `10 Oct 2026` *(Date Picker, Mandatory)*
*   **Applicant Status** : `[Dropdown/Text Field]`

### **Section: Nama & Ketersediaan (Kanan Atas)**
*   **Display Name** : `[Text Field]`
*   **Middle Name** : `[Text Field]`
*   **Date Available** : `[Date Picker]`
*   **Blacklist** : `[Checkbox]` *(Unchecked)*
*   **Suspend** : `[Checkbox]` *(Unchecked)*

### **Section: Rekrutmen & Penempatan (Bawah)**
*   **Job Opportunity Ref No** : `[Text Field]`
*   **Applicant Receiving Company** : `MII - Mitra Industri Internasional` *(Lookup/Text dengan nilai default)*
*   **Point of Hire** : `[Dropdown]` *(Panah dropdown terlihat)*
*   **Send Receive Date** : `[Date Picker]`
*   **Send Rejection Date** : `[Date Picker]`
*   **Keep on File Duration** : `12` *(Numeric/Text, default value 12)*

### **Elemen UI Tambahan**
*   **Tombol Aksi**: `Save` (Biru), `Cancel` (Abu)
*   **Header**: Applicant Information
*   **Navigasi Kiri**: Menu HR Base, Payroll, Recruitment, Training Administration, dsb.
